issues.problem: Every machine construction recipe is an `assembler` recipe with required_tier 4 (6 for tier 10), and they are the only recipes that produce assembler_tier_3 and assembler_tier_4. To make the first Assembler you already need a Tier 4 Assembler, so no player can ever get an Assembler, Inscriber or Centrifuge. The recipes for tier 3 machines also need a tier 4 assembler. Tier 6 also has a second path (`assembler_tier_6_upgrade`) next to the hull+gear recipe, and the generic `hull + 4 dense_clay_gear` / `hull + spindle×max(tier-4,1)` / `e(1,tier)` formulas are not traced to the original data.
issues.reason: The AC requires that all 10 machines and the parts needed for progression can be made, using the original values. Right now the progression cannot start.
issues.fix: Generate the construction recipe for each of the 10 machines from the original hotfix2 CRecipes. Use shaped crafting where the original uses the crafting table (at least the entry Assembler/Inscriber/Centrifuge tier), and use assembler recipes with the original inputs, required tier, CE and ticks for the rest. Keep only the paths the original has. Add a GameTest that checks every machine can be obtained, starting from items that are already craftable.

history.note: fixed: Tier 3・4 の機械を原作の作業台パターンで製作可能にし、高Tier の材料を修正して余分なアップグレード経路を削除しました。
Tier 3/4 machines now use shaped crafting from craftable hulls. Higher tiers use assembler recipes. The extra tier 6 upgrade path was removed. A GameTest checks that every machine can be obtained.
The diff does not touch the construction recipes, so the earlier fix still holds.

issues.problem: `startProcess` now stops with OUTPUT_FULL when `fixedOutputs` is empty, and `outputsMatch` returns false for an empty fixed list. Before this change, recipes with only `random_outputs` (or only fluid outputs) could run. Now they never start, and an active one is aborted on every reload check.
issues.reason: This breaks the M03/M06 recipe contract (any one non-empty output array is enough) for every machine that shares this BlockEntity.
issues.fix: Treat an empty fixed-output list as allowed: only check space for the fixed outputs when there are some, and in `outputsMatch` return true when the fixed list is empty. Reject only recipes whose fixed output count is larger than `outputSlots`.

history.note: fixed: 固定アイテム出力が空でも処理を許可し、出力スロット数を超える場合だけ拒否します。
Empty fixed outputs are allowed. Only recipes with more item outputs than outputSlots are rejected, and outputsMatch no longer rejects an empty list.
The diff does not touch the fixed-output handling in ClayMachineBlockEntity, so the earlier fix still holds.

issues.problem: The load code falls back to the old `pending_output` key, which is migration code for an older format of a mod that has not been released.
issues.reason: AGENTS.md says old-world migration is not implemented, and the style rules ask to remove code the current behavior does not need.
issues.fix: Remove the `pending_output` fallback branch and read only `pending_outputs`.

history.note: fixed: 旧 pending_output キーの読込分岐を削除しました。
The pending_output fallback is gone; a grep finds no remaining use.
The diff does not touch the NBT load code, so the earlier removal of the pending_output fallback still holds.

issues.problem: There is no M13 section. The 10 machine IDs, the slot layout (inputs/outputs/reserved/fuel with `outputSlots`), the 5 machine hull IDs and tiers, the recipe ID groups, the GUI `required_energy` display, the GameTest names and `tests/e2e/assembly-machines.mjs` are not documented. The M06 NBT key list still says `pending_output`, but the code now saves `pending_outputs`.
issues.reason: The project rules require AGENTS.md to be updated in the same change when IDs, registrations, saved data or verification steps change.
issues.fix: Add an M13 section covering these items, and change the M06 saved NBT key list to `pending_outputs`. Also state that the GUI shows the required CE instead of the stored CE.

history.note: fixed: M13 の登録、スロット、保存、レシピ、GUI、検証を AGENTS.md に記載しました。
AGENTS.md has an M13 section, and the M06 NBT key list now says pending_outputs.
The diff does not touch AGENTS.md, so the M13 section and the pending_outputs key list are unchanged.

issues.problem: The 2×2 centrifuge output grid sits at x 115–151, y 25–61. It overlaps the state label drawn at (80,58) ("Processing"/"処理中" reaches past x 115), and long titles drawn at y 21 run into the top output row.
issues.reason: The GUI is captured to show progress, slots and Tier in a readable way. Overlapping text and slots make the centrifuge screen hard to read.
issues.fix: Move the multi-output grid, or the state and energy labels, so they do not overlap (for example, put the labels below y 62, or shift the grid up or right). Check the result in the E2E screenshot.

history.note: fixed: 遠心分離機の出力枠とタイトル幅を調整し、ラベルとの重なりを解消しました。
The output grid moved to x 132–168, y 18–54, and the title width is limited to 120 for multi-output machines, so they no longer overlap the labels. I did not check the E2E screenshot.

The multi-output grid now sits at x 132–168, y 26–62 (outputY base is now 26). The title width is capped at 120, so it ends at x 127. The state label at (80,58) and the required-energy label at (80,69) do not reach the grid. I did not look at the E2E screenshot.

issues.problem: The screen no longer shows the stored CE, so `storedEnergy()` is now unused, and data slots 8–11 are synced for nothing.
issues.reason: The style rules say to remove code that the current behavior no longer uses.
issues.fix: Either show the stored CE next to the required CE, or remove `storedEnergy()` and the unused ContainerData indices, and renumber the slots.

history.note: fixed: 未使用の保存 CE 表示メソッドと同期データを削除しました。
storedEnergy() and the old data slots 8–11 were removed, and the remaining indices and count (14) are consistent.
The diff does not bring back storedEnergy() or the old data slots.

issues.reason: The style rules ask for one direct path per behavior and no duplicate code.
issues.fix: Generate the assembly machine models through the existing `MachineBlockStateProvider.machine` logic (add the `AssemblyMachineRegistration.MACHINES` loop there). Keep only the hull models in a separate provider, or move them into the same provider.

history.note: fixed: 機械モデルの生成を既存 Provider に統合しました。
The assembly machine models are now generated by MachineBlockStateProvider, and the duplicate machine() was removed from AssemblyMachineModels.
The diff does not touch the datagen providers, so the earlier merge into MachineBlockStateProvider still holds.

issues.problem: `legacyName(series)` is a hand-written switch that maps each series to the catalog's legacy name. The catalog can already be matched by `namedIdStem().equals(series.recipeMethod().id())`, which is what the GameTest does.
issues.reason: This is an extra mapping that can drift from the catalog. The style asks for one direct path.
issues.fix: Look up the MachineFamily by `namedIdStem()` equal to `series.recipeMethod().id()` and delete `legacyName`.

history.note: fixed: 台帳の namedIdStem で系列を検索し、重複した名前対応を削除しました。
legacyName was deleted, and the series is found by namedIdStem equal to recipeMethod().id().
The diff does not touch AssemblyMachineRegistration, so legacyName stays removed.

issues.problem: `hotfixTwoAssemblyBalancesAndCeValuesArePreserved` checks only tier, CE, ticks and outputs, not the input ingredients and counts, so the production balance is only half-checked. The final `require(ClayiumRecipeEnergy.e(1.0D,10) == 100_000_000L)` tests a math helper, not any recipe against the reduced 1.12.2 value. Hull recipes and Inscriber/Centrifuge construction recipes are not checked at all.
issues.reason: The criterion asks for the production balance of the main intermediate materials and original (non-reduced) CE values. The test should assert the recipe data against the original numbers.
issues.fix: Assert the inputs (item and count) of each listed recipe as well, include the hull and all 10 machine construction recipes with their original values, and remove the tautological `e(1,10)` check.

history.note: fixed: 主要レシピの入力数と品目、筐体と全10機種の製作経路を GameTest で検証します。
Input items and counts are now asserted. Hull and all machine construction recipes are covered by the new GameTest. The tautological e(1,10) check was removed.
The diff does not touch the assembly GameTest, so the input and recipe assertions still hold.

issues.problem: The only automated check that the displayed CE matches the CE actually consumed is `centrifugemultioutputstopssavesandconsumesexactlyonce`, and it is mapped only to AC-F012-001. AC-F012-002 has only the screenshot scenario, which cannot check that the values match.
issues.reason: The expected result of AC-F012-002 says the displayed value and the consumed CE must match. That needs a mapped assertion.
issues.fix: Add a GameTest mapped to AC-F012-002 (or map an existing one) that runs each of the 3 series, compares the menu's synced `requiredEnergy()` with the CE actually consumed, and list it under AC-F012-002.

history.note: fixed: 3系列それぞれの GUI 同期 CE と実消費 CE を比較する GameTest を AC-F012-002 に登録しました。
A new GameTest compares the menu's synced requiredEnergy() with the CE actually consumed for all three series, and it is mapped to AC-F012-002 in acceptance.json.
The diff does not touch the AC-F012-002 GameTest or its mapping in acceptance.json, so the earlier fix still holds.

issues.problem: The centrifuge's 2×2 output grid sits right against the face-mode button row. The top edge of the upper two output slots touches the bottoms of the W:I and E:I buttons, and the grid reaches up into the title band. The layout looks crowded and broken compared with the single-output machines.
issues.reason: ClayMachineMenu.outputY returns 18 + row*18 for multi-output machines, so the slot background is drawn at y=17. The face buttons in ClayMachineScreen.init cover y=4..18, so the two overlap by 1–2 GUI pixels with no gap.
issues.fix: Move the multi-output grid down so it starts below the button row and title, for example outputY = 26 + row*18 with the grid centred on the arrow row (y≈35 ± 9). Alternatively shrink or move the face buttons. Move the slot positions in ClayMachineMenu and the background blits in ClayMachineScreen together, and keep at least a 2px gap between the buttons and the slots.

history.note: fixed: 遠心分離機の出力枠を下げ、面設定ボタンとの間隔を確保しました。スロットと背景は同じ座標を使用します。
In the centrifuge screenshot the 2×2 output grid now starts well below the face-mode button row. There is a clear gap, and the grid no longer reaches into the title band.

issues.problem: The status reads 'Processing', but the progress arrow is completely empty and every machine slot (both inputs, the output and fuel) is empty. The screenshot does not show any processing progress or which material is being assembled. The inscriber screenshot has the same problem.
issues.reason: The scenario only runs `tick step 3` before opening the GUI. The fill width is computed as (int)(24*progress/required), which truncates to 0 for small progress. The inputs are also moved to the hidden pending slots, so nothing visible shows that work is happening.
issues.fix: Make the screenshot show progress: advance enough ticks before capture (for example step until progress is about 30–60%), and/or draw at least 1px of fill whenever progress > 0. Leave part of the input stack visible in the input slot (or show the in-process item next to the arrow) so the GUI shows which recipe is running.

history.note: fixed: 組立機を約40%まで進めて撮影し、予約済みの入力素材を GUI に表示します。進捗がある場合は矢印を最低1px描画します。

The assembler screenshot now shows progress. The arrow has a white fill, and the input slots show the in-process items (a pattern item and a 32-count stack). The status and CE value (187.500) are visible.

issues.problem: The inscriber also shows 'Processing' with an empty progress arrow and empty input and output slots, so its processing progress is not visible.
issues.reason: Same cause as the assembler: 3 ticks of progress truncate to a 0px fill, and the consumed inputs are stored in pending slots that the GUI does not show.
issues.fix: Use the same fix as the assembler screenshot: capture after more ticks or render a minimum 1px fill when progress > 0, and keep the in-process item visible.

history.note: fixed: 印刷機も個別に進めてから撮影し、処理中の素材と矢印の進捗を表示します。

The inscriber screenshot now shows its input items, but the progress arrow is still fully gray with no fill. The assembler and centrifuge arrows both show a white fill. The 'Processing' status therefore still has no visible progress for the inscriber.
fixed: 120 tickの印刷レシピを撮影前に45 tick進め、入力品を表示したまま矢印に十分な進捗幅が出るようにしました。

issues.problem: The player-inventory label shows the Simplified Chinese '物品栏', while the machine title, state and CE text are in English. The GUI text is in mixed languages. The inscriber and centrifuge screenshots have the same label.
issues.reason: The E2E client is running with a zh_cn locale. The mod only ships en_us and ja_jp, so its strings fall back to English while the vanilla `container.inventory` resolves to Chinese.
issues.fix: Set the harness client language to en_us (or ja_jp) in the clayium-a instance options so that every label in the GUI uses one locale that the mod supports.

history.note: fixed: 在庫ラベルを Mod の英日翻訳へ移し、撮影クライアントの言語が zh_cn でも他の Mod 表示と同じ英語にフォールバックさせました。
The player-inventory label now reads 'Inventory' in English in all three GUI screenshots. The Chinese '物品栏' is gone and the GUI text is in one language.

issues.problem: The machine icon between the inputs and the progress arrow is only a small, partly transparent fragment (a dark band about 12×9 px for the inscriber and assembler). It does not look like the machine front, so it is hard to tell which machine it is.
issues.reason: ClayMachineScreen blits only `textures/block/<series front>.png`. That PNG is a transparent overlay that the block model draws on top of the hull, so drawing it alone leaves most of the 16×16 area empty.
issues.fix: Draw the tier's hull texture (machinehull-(tier-1)) first and the front overlay on top at the same 16×16 position, or render the machine's block item, so the icon matches the placed block front.

history.note: fixed: 機械アイコンに Tier の筐体テクスチャを描き、その上へ正面テクスチャを重ねました。
The machine icon is now a full 16×16 tile showing the tier hull with the front overlay on top. It is clearly recognisable as the machine front in the assembler, inscriber and centrifuge GUIs.
